description: Na₃MnCO₃PO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.74 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.41 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-58°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom.
